# Status-indicator map — which RV-C instances can drive an on-screen indicator

*Generated by `src/fireflymcf/status_map.py` (build 13.6). Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `python3 -m fireflymcf.status_map firefly-13.6/mcf.bin`.*

## 1. Mechanism (GUICODE Finding 33)

LCD hands GuiCode's paint tick the receive-filter **slot-array base** `0x20007fc8`, which reaches the 25 KB `FUN_00247BF8`. That function reads `slot[var]` at a **hard-coded** immediate `ldrsh [r4,#2*var]` and writes the decoded on/off **colour** (a `str` word) and **bool** (a `strb` byte) into `0x2003xxxx` SRAM cells. A widget shows the live state when its record's **fillA mode-7 colour index** resolves through the `GuiData+0x44BC8` table to that colour cell (and/or its `value_slot` resolves to the bool cell). So a status instance is *usable* for a lit indicator iff `FUN_00247BF8` bridges it **and** its colour cell is present in that table (INDEXED); otherwise the pointer must be inserted (relocator).

## 2. Backbone — every status instance (floorplan-independent, `proven-from-code`)

`var` = variable-table index (= receive-filter slot). `bridged` = `FUN_00247BF8` has a clean 2-dest `ldrsh [r4,#2*var]` block. `colour idx` / `bool vslot` = the `0x44BC8` table index of the colour / bool cell (blank colour idx = **UNINDEXED**). `cmd` = commanded by a located single-channel control. Consumers are the objects currently reading each cell.

## 3. Recommended targets — Tier 1 (high confidence, floorplan-independent)

Free (not commanded), bridged, colour cell **indexed**, and the colour cell is consumed **only by off-page diagnostic/config indicators** (no floorplan light-grid object, no walk-visible on-page control) and never displayed on any floorplan. These stay valid across **all 14 floorplans** — the safest same-size-edit targets.

| instance | var | fillA mode-7 colour idx | value_slot (bool) | colour cell | consumer(s) |

| 15 | 32 | 145 | 67 | 0x2003a2fc | 250 |
| 19 | 36 | 164 | 73 | 0x2003a2e0 | 352, 406, 407 |
| 20 | 37 | 165 | 75 | 0x2003a3b4 | 352, 406, 407 |
| 27 | 69 | 310 | 85 | 0x2003a6b4 | 835 |

| 29 | 71 | 312 | 87 | 0x2003a6c4 | 837 |
| 30 | 72 | 313 | 88 | 0x200399bc | 837 |
| 31 | 73 | 143 | 89 | 0x20039b5c | 232 |

The **purest** targets are those whose only consumer is an off-page *diagnostic* indicator (the G12-OUTPUTS / model-config status grids) rather than a named sub-screen control — currently instances **27, 28, 29, 30** (consumers obj 835/837). The rest (15/19/20/31) share their colour cell with a control on a non-floorplan sub-screen (Start / GEN / Low), so the instance may be wired to that function; still same-size-editable, but confirm the instance is spare on the coach.

## 5. Tier 2 — free + bridged but UNINDEXED colour cell (needs a relocator insert)

These have a live status feed but no table entry for the colour cell, so a lit indicator needs a pointer-table insertion (relocator), not a same-size edit — e.g. **instance 17**.

## 6. How to use

To light a **new cloned button**'s indicator with a **same-size edit (no relocator)**: pick a Tier-1 instance for your floorplan, command that **RV-C instance**, and set *three* fields of the cloned button to the **same** `<colour idx>` — the box record's **fillA mode-7 colour index**, the box record's **`value_slot`**, and the **caption record's `value_slot`**. `FUN_00247BF8` already reads that instance's slot every paint, so the indicator then tracks the live output. For a Tier-2 instance (e.g. 17), the colour cell must first be inserted into the `0x44BC8` table via the relocator.

**Use the colour index for all three, not the `bool vslot` column.** The mode-7 colour table and the value-slot table are the same table (GUICODE Finding 18), so index N and slot N are one cell, and the live-redraw invariant (`MCF-FORMAT.md` §6.0a) requires all three fields to name that one cell. Splitting them — fillA at the colour index while a `value_slot` names the bool cell — is a real failure mode, not a theoretical one: it was flashed (pin-15 build v7) and gave a button whose **box repainted live but whose caption vanished** until the page was re-entered. Setting all three equal (v8) fixed it on the coach. The `bool vslot` column below is documentation of where the bool cell sits, not a value to write into a widget.
